decision: Keep both candidates experimental. Small-file and directory gaps shrink, but random I/O regressions and synchronization tails remain. No production format or policy change.

host.scope: Whole window, including monitor baseline, untimed work and unrelated host activity; not candidate-attributed.

initial.caveat: Instrumented native phases are diagnostic, not FUSE throughput; first_sync and bulk_sync include close/unlink. Foreground/worker timings overlap.

kernel_wait_diagnosis.caveat: 10 ms samples of owned threads, not exact syscall duration. Full kernel stacks denied. No attribution to WBT, another job or physical SSD cause.

limitations: Isolated Linux/local-filesystem format 1004; no migration, remote backend, online backup or physical power-cut certification.
All writes, checkpoints and GC must use managed native connections. Raw SQLite inspection is only used for controlled test fixtures.
All scalar samples, including severe stalls, retained. Windows are separate and must not be pooled or selectively substituted.
Read timings use warm data. Separate reference comparison explicitly distinguishes writable-handle FUSE reads and settled readonly kernel caching.
Source reconstruction matches the tested copies. Production package and default SQLite BLOB format are unchanged.
